files.name: motion-prompt-086.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Underline animation" (下線アニメーション), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #086

What it is: A link's underline grows from the left on hover
What the sample shows: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.
Spec:
- Three links (20 px, bold, 56 apart). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s (hit area 6 px wider than the text on each side).
- Underline: orange, 3 thick, 8 px below the baseline.
- On hover, width 0→100% from the left end over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out).
- On leave, the left end moves right over 0.3 s, so the line exits to the right (like scaleX with transform-origin on the right).
When to use it: Use it on menu and text links to show where the pointer is, quietly.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/086.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
